domain: position and velocity are valid arena IDs referring to plain mutable two-element Number arrays
position and velocity may alias the same array; all arena identities and writes are preserved
direction and delta time are JavaScript Number values represented as binary64
Entity fields and vector elements have no getters, setters, proxies, prototype interception or concurrent mutation
Trace observers are nonthrowing, nonreentrant and do not mutate the entity or arena
NaN sign and payload bits are diagnostic; the supported JS semantic domain requires only NaN classification

trace.input: positionID velocityID directionBits deltaTimeBits then pairs of binary64 hex arena values; arena length inferred
trace.output: One JSON object per input with events array; numeric values encoded as sixteen lowercase hexadecimal digits
trace.numericPolicy: All non-NaN values require exact bits; --strict-bits also requires exact NaN bits
